text: Arkhan has established a Necropolis nearby, bringing this region into his Land of the Dead.
Arkhan has drained this province of life. The dead now roam its necromantic wasteland under his command.

[[col:green]]• Province climate becomes Undead Wasteland.\\n• Arkhan’s buildings can generate Necromantic Energy.[[/col]]\\n[[col:yellow]]• Wizard Caliph’s Palace anchors his first Necropolis; burial mounds in other provincial capitals can establish more.\\n• Ritual cost rises after each cast and falls with Vampiric Corruption.[[/col]]
Arkhan enacts a ritual that drains all vital essence from the surrounding land. Mortal or immortal, animate or inanimate, all is consumed, leaving swathes of devastation in the ritual's wake.
[[col:green]]Climate of each Region within the Province is converted to Undead Wasteland[[/col]]
[[col:yellow]]Wizard Caliph's Palace anchors Arkhan's first Necropolis; burial mounds in other provincial capitals can establish more.[[/col]]
[[col:yellow]]The cost of the Ritual of Undeath increases each time it is cast, but can be reduced by Vampiric Corruption.[[/col]]
